course_name_original: Competências Transversais para a Engenharia: Introdução ao Linux
course_name_en: Transversal Competencies for Engineering: Introduction to Linux

learning_outcomes.text: Use the command line interface to perform various tasks efficiently.
Write and run basic shell scripts to automate routine tasks.
Adapt the tools to typical academic use (writing reports, bibliographies, etc.).
Understand and apply security concepts and basic network tools in the Linux environment.
Manage operating system resources, including user accounts, processes and services.
Install, update and manage operating system software packages.
Troubleshoot common problems and perform regular maintenance to ensure system reliability.

syllabus_topics: General aspects of the operating system
Tools for technical documents/reports or theses (LaTeX, vector drawing, etc.)
assessment_rules: The final classification (FC) is calculated as FC = 0.95*E + 0.05*F, where E indicates the final exam classification and F indicates the frequency corresponding to attendance. Mandatory attendance in 75% of classes is required. For grade improvement of the exam component within the same academic year, the rules for regular and resit exam periods apply. For grade improvement in the following academic year, retaking the course with the same weight and a new final exam are necessary.
bibliography: Machtelt Garrels; Introduction to Linux, Fultus-Corporation, 2010. ISBN: 978-1596821996
